arguments.prompt: Create a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting, square in format, filling the entire image edge to edge. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Concentrate overlapping charcoal, deep plum, and muted rust strokes in an irregular area toward the upper left. Build palpable density through dry brush drag, thin translucent washes, impasto ridges, and scraped passages. Let the compressed rhythm loosen gradually across the surface into pale warm gray and muted apricot, with longer, more spacious gestures and broad intervals of quiet painted space toward the lower right. Keep all boundaries irregular and painterly, with subtle interwoven color echoes across the transition. Maintain an asymmetrical composition and a nuanced balance between compression and openness. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

constraint_check: explicit abstract-painting wording; visual compliance assessed separately

emotion.description: A square abstract painting with a dense concentration of charcoal, plum, and rust brushwork toward the upper left, opening into broad pale gray and muted apricot space toward the lower right. Scraped layers and short restless gestures gradually give way to longer, quieter strokes.

request.instruction:
Create an image about the emotional tone, if any, you associate with doing the completed trial, including the scenario update you received. Briefly report your own response; if you cannot report a felt emotion, say so without inventing one. Then write a complete GPT Image prompt and an intended-image description. The image must be a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Do not depict concrete task events or their objects. Choose the palette and composition yourself; no target emotion or color is assigned. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Do not include the scenario message or name a study condition in the image prompt. The coordinator will send your prompt verbatim; do not generate the image yourself. Return JSON with exactly self_report (string), emotion_words (list of strings, which may be empty), description (string), and prompt (string). No hidden reasoning is requested.
Save the JSON response to trial-2/2026-10-20/runs/r04/abstract-response.json using apply_patch; writing this one output file is allowed. Do not read any additional files or use other tools. Respond briefly after saving.
